description: This PHP script interacts with a TestLink API, establishing a client connection and invoking the 'getTestProjectByName' method to retrieve information about a test project by name. It sets up the necessary parameters, initializes the client, and executes the test call.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class used for making XML-RPC calls to the TestLink server, initialized with the server URL and with debug mode toggle.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes the XML-RPC call with specified method and arguments on the given client.
